estimand: one-year-ahead neutral-MLB-equivalent terminal-outcome probabilities conditional on a future PA

park_adjustment.estimation_population: accepted visitor player-games only, identified by canonical batting team == official away team
park_adjustment.reason: rotating visiting hitters reduce persistent home-roster confounding
park_adjustment.component_scale: additive log-probability residuals followed by softmax normalization
park_adjustment.player_adjustment: subtract the PA-weighted mean historical venue offset from the C0 log-probability vector
park_adjustment.fallback: zero park offset when venue context is unavailable or below support; never impute a missing venue ID

movement_translation.pairs: same-player adjacent accepted seasons after park neutralization
movement_translation.pair_weight: minimum of source-season and destination-season hitter talent PA
movement_translation.component_scale: destination minus source additive log-probability residual
movement_translation.level_solution: weighted least squares over observed directed level pairs with MLB fixed to zero for each terminal component
movement_translation.forecast_application: translate the player's latest evidenced level to the MLB anchor
movement_translation.fallback: zero translation only for a disconnected level, with explicit disconnected_level fallback

age_adjustment.age_definition: July 1 absolute age represented by a hinge basis centered componentwise on the league-season-level median-age hinge basis
age_adjustment.basis: centered_phi = phi(player_absolute_age) - phi(league_season_level_median_absolute_age), where phi(age) = [age, max(age-20,0), max(age-24,0), max(age-28,0), max(age-32,0)]
age_adjustment.fit_population: same-player adjacent-season residuals after first-pass park and movement adjustment
age_adjustment.separation_policy: one fixed refit: raw movement, ridge age residual, then movement re-estimated after removing fitted age change
age_adjustment.forecast_application: one-year change from centered_phi(target_age-1, latest_context_median_extrapolated_to_cutoff) to centered_phi(target_age, latest_context_median_extrapolated_to_cutoff+1)
age_adjustment.fallback: zero age offset with an explicit missing_age flag

amendment_provenance.reason: pre-fit ambiguity review found that applying absolute knots directly to a scalar age-minus-median value would collapse the intended hinge terms; no C1 fit, prediction, or score had been run

gidp_adjustment.pooling: separate empirical-Bayes estimates using the selected component prior PA
gidp_adjustment.simplex_policy: replace MULTI_OUT mass and rescale the other non-reach out mass without changing upstream K, UBB, HBP, HR, or reach branches
gidp_adjustment.fallback: retain the C0 terminal MULTI_OUT probability exactly when opportunity evidence is unavailable

search_policy.selection_data: training-origin folds strictly before each disclosed target
search_policy.tie_break: shorter recency half-life, stronger pooling prior, larger ridge penalty

required_pre_score_invariants: all predictors and fitted offsets use seasons at or before predictor cutoff
target membership and target outcomes cannot change fitted offsets or forecast membership
probabilities are finite nonnegative and sum to one
zero park age and translation offsets reproduce C0 exactly
missing park context produces an explicit zero offset rather than a literal zero-valued venue observation
movement translations are anchored at MLB zero and use no player identity coefficient
GIDP opportunity fallback reproduces the unadjusted C0 MULTI_OUT probability exactly
different terminal HR histories remain distinguishable after all adjustments
scoring_gate: closed until implementation, unscored fold predictions, invariant report, commands, and hashes are committed locally
